verdict.rationale: Circle documents key management abstraction (MPC/passkeys, no raw private keys), gas sponsorship/paymasters so developers never touch chain mechanics, and REST APIs plus Web/Mobile SDKs (Android/iOS) as the integration surface. missing for 10: broader language coverage beyond Web/Mobile SDKs (e.g., server-side/backend client libraries in Python, Java, etc.) and independent hands-on developer corroboration of the abstraction working smoothly in practice.
